_meta.title: Four-Color Breadth Harvest — bulk witness table (sibling of fourcolor_witness_gallery.json)
_meta.owner: Grace (schema + custody); Elie (generator + measurement, W1/W2); Cal (population-fairness gate + confidence ledger)
_meta.round: CI_BOARD Round 77 — Cal's softest-place ruling: every celebrated vocabulary reads the SAME six base graphs; a vocabulary that survives a population it didn't grow up on is a theory
_meta.relationship_to_gallery: The gallery (FCW-###) holds NAMED, individually-verified witnesses with full provenance. This table holds hundreds of bulk rows, one per generated witness, measured wholesale on every axis. PROMOTION RULE: a bulk row that becomes load-bearing (a kill, a new invariant's birth certificate, a false-neighbor pair) is PROMOTED to an FCW ID in the gallery with its harvest row_id recorded — the row itself is never deleted.
_meta.conventions: Counts k/N, never percentages. Instrument fingerprint carried over from the gallery: corrected face-tracked pipeline (861->862 fingerprint; sorted-order labels are the poisoned instrument — any row produced by one is invalid, not merely stale). Dedup key MUST be declared per family (full-coloring vs link-color-tuple resolutions differ; both legitimate, never mixed silently).
_meta.blind_protocol: W2 order is LOAD-BEARING and recorded per row: (1) fibers computed and FILED (gf2_fiber_id, z_fiber) with reachability fields EMPTY; (2) file checkpoint hash posted; (3) reachability/depth measured and filled in. The 'blind_stamp' field carries the checkpoint reference so target-innocence at scale is auditable, not asserted. Any row with reachability filled before its blind_stamp is quarantined (quarantine=true), not deleted.
_meta.population_fairness: Cal-RULED (round 7, Cal 788): SIX strata (supersedes the draft five-family list). Leaving-home strata = random / degree-diverse / adversarial ONLY — never first-found sampling. Instrument-saturation reads UNRESOLVED until Cal rules otherwise. Every row carries its stratum tag; the exact six-strata definitions are Cal's artifact — cite his ruling, do not paraphrase.
_meta.fairness_status: GATE RULED (six strata, Cal 788); W1 generator built and PARKED at the gate (92 graphs with provenance); mass production awaits 'run it'
_meta.kill_semantics: THE TEST THAT MATTERS (W2): any same-gf2-fiber unreachable pair kills the complete-invariant conjecture — that pair is promoted to the gallery same-hour as the next invariant's birth certificate. Zero kills at scale = the strongest evidence this program has produced, in Cal's confidence language (his ruling on what N-at-scale earns what wording — do not paraphrase it here, cite his ledger entry when it exists).
_meta.crown_deliverable: THE SPANNING PROFILE (round 8): rank of available straddle-indicators per coloring, across hundreds of witnesses, with frozen objects as the PREDICTED rank-drop sites. Per Lemma R, this one table either locates the obstruction to Availability Saturation (SPANNING gap) or shows there isn't one.
_meta.tranche_riders: Cal's 4 riders (round 8): (1) tranche 2 owes law-targeting adversarial families; (2) deg-7+ carriers REQUIRED — the charge theorem's +/-3-at-deg-7 has NEVER been observed (natal six contain none); (3) natal-derived flags exclude tower-DNA from breadth statistics; (4) randomness gets a mixing diagnostic. Pipeline blind-by-construction: fibers sha256-checkpointed before reachability computes.
_meta.first_observation_watch: RESOLVED — FIRST OBSERVATION BANKED (round 9): 4,184 deg-7 readings across 92 foreign graphs, every one exactly +/-3. The pre-registered can-fail clause CONFIRMED at scale. Historical text of the watch preserved in git.
_meta.tranche_status: Tranche 1 LANDED: 92 foreign graphs; ASC survives first contact (ZERO closed-component kills); F1 provably mixes; deficiency axis 0-95. Tranche 2 next under Cal's riders: law-targeting adversarial families + the deficiency correlation table (deficiency vs depth, freezing, gate statistics — the spanning profile's first law-shaped table).

schema.row_id: H-###### monotone, never reused (same rule as FCW IDs)
schema.generator: generator name + version + seed — the row must be regenerable bit-identically

odd_geometry.s2_radius3_odd: int (odd vertices within distance 3 of stuck vertex)

charge.deg7_carrier: bool + observed charge value if present — first-observation flag, see _meta.first_observation_watch

schema.gf2_fiber_id: fiber identifier in the GF(2) sign-pattern/face-space lens (the candidate complete invariant)
schema.blind_stamp: checkpoint reference proving fibers were filed before reachability was read

verdict_flags.same_gf2_unreachable_pair: bool — TRUE is a kill; promote to gallery same-hour
verdict_flags.false_neighbor: bool (identical full linear data, different depth)

gf2_spanning.available_indicator_rank: int — rank of the available straddle-indicator set at this coloring (the crown column)
gf2_spanning.subspace_dim: int — dim of the ambient indicator subspace for this graph
gf2_spanning.deficiency: int — subspace_dim minus available rank; 0 = saturated
gf2_spanning.rank_drop_site: bool — predicted TRUE exactly at frozen/stuck objects (Lemma R); a saturated frozen object or a deficient free one is a FINDING either way

schema.stratum: one of Cal's six ruled strata (supersedes the draft 'family' tag; keep 'family' for generator lineage)
schema.w_quantifier_note: W columns are per-GRAPH; M_C (motion space) is per-Kempe-class — pinned round 9, do not conflate (they differ exactly at frozen objects)

pinning_census._meta: The availability atlas: censused boundary pinnings of the disc (round 10: 5,000 pinnings, 15 pathological — one shape). S1 BLIND PROTOCOL (Cal-gated before run): slope/winding classes computed and FILED+HASHED for all pinnings BEFORE the frozen flags are joined — same discipline as the fiber checkpoint. Prediction on file: the 15 pathological pinnings are exactly the extremal-slope class. Both anomaly directions pre-scored as headlines.

schema.boundary_word: the pinned color word on the boundary cycle
schema.slope_class: boundary height/winding class. v1 (disp-sum) REFUTED round 11 — 12/15 frozen at slope zero, extremal free. v2 = the PROVED dictionary's canonical height, blind protocol identical, Cal's no-recalibration guard in force. Column carries version tag: slope_v1 (dead, kept) / slope_v2.
schema.blind_stamp: hash checkpoint proving slope filed before frozen flags joined
schema.pathological: bool — two-node both-frozen zero-edge twin pair
schema.filler: bool + which color/parity class — one color occupying an ENTIRE parity class ('half-crystallized boundary'). NECESSITY STAT on record: 15/15 frozen have filler vs ~1/9 base rate among free (round 11, S1). Law language Cal-gated. U1 target: the sufficient completion (filler + WHAT <=> frozen).
